aboutHeading: 40 Years HVAC Excellence in Sunshine West
aboutText: With over 40 years of experience, Tonna Heat & Cool has been the trusted HVAC partner for Sunshine West and surrounding areas. We specialise in ducted heaters, evaporative coolers, and refrigerated systems, ensuring your home stays comfortable year-round. Our local team is committed to quality installation, maintenance, and safety checks like carbon monoxide testing.
servicesSubheading: Expert solutions for Sunshine West homes
servicesText: At Tonna Heat & Cool, we offer a full range of HVAC services including installation, repair, and maintenance. From heating to cooling, our team handles ducted systems, split units, and safety testing. We tailor solutions to Melbourne's climate for efficient and reliable performance.

services.title: Carbon Monoxide Testing
services.desc: Essential safety inspections for heating systems to detect and prevent carbon monoxide risks in your home.

services.title: Ducted Heater Installation
services.desc: Professional setup of efficient ducted heating to provide consistent warmth throughout your property during winter.

services.title: Evaporative Cooler Solutions
services.desc: Installation and service of evaporative coolers, ideal for Melbourne's dry summers, offering natural air circulation.

services.title: Refrigerated Air Conditioning
services.desc: Reverse cycle and refrigerated systems for precise temperature control, keeping you cool in summer and warm in winter.

services.title: Split System Air Conditioning
services.desc: Multi-head split systems for targeted cooling and heating in individual rooms, perfect for varied home layouts.

services.title: Hydronic Heating Systems
services.desc: Advanced water-based heating solutions for even, silent warmth, suitable for larger homes and energy efficiency.
